title: euclea racemosa subsp. schimperi
intro: Euclea racemosa subsp. schimperi, commonly known as the "African willow tree" or "Tamboti", is a plant species native to the savannas of sub-Saharan Africa. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, pain, and fever, as well as treating various infections and digestive issues. The health benefits of Euclea racemosa subsp. schimperi are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
